# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.0-alpha.1-internal.1897 (loopback protocol check)
name: "Jev code review routing"
version: "1.0"
agents: []
orchestrator:
  name: decision
  strategy: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: classify
        type: decision
        decision:
          backend: jev
          input: {from: query}
          questions:
            queue:
              type: choice
              instructions: "Which engineering review queue should handle this change?"
              choices:
                security: "Authentication, authorization or sensitive data"
                database: "Schema or storage changes"
                general: "Other code changes"
